core_questions.question: When did you first notice these symptoms, and have they been continuous or coming and going?
core_questions.safety_implication: Distinguishes hyperacute, acute, subacute, and chronic presentations.

core_questions.question: On a scale from 0 to 10 (where 0 is no discomfort and 10 is unbearable pain), how would you describe the severity?
What age group applies to the person experiencing these symptoms, and are there any pre-existing health conditions?
core_questions.safety_implication: Age extremes (< 3 months, > 65) or chronic conditions alter triage thresholds.

counterfactuals.condition: If acute difficulty breathing, chest pain, or slurred speech develops
If symptoms progressively worsen or severity reaches 8-10
If symptoms remain mild and resolve within 48-72 hours
